value.rationale: Complete arithmetic isomorphism invariants, ideal lattice and refined automorphism-group order spectra for a natural infinite sparse cyclic evolution-algebra family provide a motivated structural classification beyond routine isolated examples. The full singularity count and Möbius-inverted symmetry census resolve natural previously unenumerated finite-field quantities, and the q-1 not-dividing-n threshold sharpens concrete cyclic-group realizations over very small fields. No unrelated downstream theorem is assumed.
